summary: Defines how content delivery networks that interconnect (CDNI) can advertise where they can serve users and what they are able to deliver, using the ALTO protocol as the carrier. RFC 8008 describes what such advertisements should mean; this document supplies the concrete protocol encoding. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Two pizza shops want to share customers. Each needs to tell the other which streets it delivers to and what it can make. This is a standard note format for sharing that list.
